summary: When PICOTokens cannot split a claim and a provider key is configured, one LLM call splits it so the PICO gate can run; the gate used is reported as relevance_gate.
reason: Most claims have no polarity verb to split on, so the weaker title/topic overlap gate usually ran. Issue #2327 measured that an LLM split roughly halves the off-topic works let through, at a small recall cost, so the gate used is reported to keep that cost visible when comparing runs.
validated_outcome: A stubbed provider covers the split path, every fallback (provider error, bad JSON, empty side, stopword-only side), the keyless path with no call, and no call when there are no works; go build, go vet and go test pass.
